author: Dr15Jones
body:
#### PR description:

Google's benchmark code is a standard way to do timing on specific pieces of code (e.g. a function). It makes sure that the relevant piece of code being tested does not get optimized away by the compiler.

The code changed in the pull request all involved running a specialized timing code to see how long a given piece of code takes to run. This was replaced with the use of Google's benchmark code.

This is a step towards removing HRRealTime.h from CMSSW as it was only used in the code changed in this PR.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles. Unit tests run.
title: Moved to using google benchmark for precision timing
